heading: Tow Tractors
benefits: High manoeuvrability facilitates use in confined spaces
Powerful motor ensures high tractive power and top speed
Large selection of trailer couplings for different trailer types
Special vehicle design allows optimum visibility of trailer and load
Suspended operator‘s platform protects against shocks and vibrations
Height-adjustable Linde steering wheel provides intuitive and precise control

vdi.label: Tyres: solid rubber, superelastic, pneumatic, polyurethane
Seat height relating to SIP/stand height
Height drawbar in driving position min./max.
Battery according to DIN 43531/35/36 A, B, C, no
Energy consumption according to DIN EN 16796
CO2 equivalent according to DIN EN 16796

footnotes.text: With optional ground clearance +50 mm → m2=100 mm
// with optional equipment fully suspended operator compartment only
h14 adjustment from -19 mm to +89 mm with adjustable tiller option.

items.text: Front anti-collision protection – rubber bumper low-mounted
Front collision protection – steel panel high-mounted
Front collision protection – steel panel high-mounted, rubber bumper low-mounted
Front collision protection – steel panel covering front of tractor
Front collision protection – steel panel covering front of tractor with 3 position trailer coupling (max. towing capacity: 1 tonne)
PIN code access (in place of key switch)
Linde BlueSpot – front-facing driving path warning light
Working lamp – front and rear LED lights
Complete lighting package (including front and rear LED, direction indicators, working, brake and reversing lights)
Linde connect:desk – local fleet management with different functional modules
Linde connect:cloud – fleet management as a service (hosted version)
Operator’s platform with cushioned floor mat
Adjustable backrest with with folding seat support
Dashboard with storage compartment (without A4 clipboard)
Multifunction colour display: hourmeter, maintenance indication, battery discharge indicator and internal fault code indication
Front panoramic and rear side mirrors
Radio data terminal mounting and power supply cable 24 V
Hook single position tow pin with cable release from operator’s position
Logistic Train Modification (includes remote control, 36 V electrical preparation, attaching socket at the rear and coupling ball and ball hitch for hooking)
Load wheels cushion rubber, non marking
Battery compartment, vertical change 3 PzS (300 Ah/375 Ah) and 4 PzS (480 Ah/620 Ah)
Battery compartment, lateral change 3 PzS (300 Ah/375 Ah) and 4 PzS (400 Ah/500 Ah), incl. ergonomic locking lever and metal rollers
Battery compartment, lateral change high 3 PzS (360 Ah/465 Ah) and 4 PzS (480 Ah/620 Ah)
Lithium-ion technology – choice of battery capacities and optional side plug for easy opportunity charging
